prompt: Create a Python module exposing an in-memory CRUD store for `task` records via a class `TaskStore`. Methods: `create(title, done=False)` returns the new record as a dict with an auto-incrementing integer `id` starting at 1, plus `title` and `done`; `get(task_id)` returns the record or None; `list(done=None)` returns all records in insertion order, filtered by `done` when it is not None; `update(task_id, **fields)` updates only the given `title`/`done` fields and returns the updated record, or None if absent; `delete(task_id)` returns True if a record was removed else False. Reject an empty or whitespace-only title with ValueError. An unknown field name in `update` raises KeyError. Records returned to callers must not alias internal state.
